text: Uma is pregnant!! Due early March. Her and Farid only told family last week so keep it quiet
Reggie's driving test is sometime next week, third attempt. He's properly nervous about it. Text him good luck the day before
alice got the promotion, team lead from end of the month. send congrats
Asha retiring after 31 years at the council. Leaving do is the Friday after next, her husband's organising it
Emeka passed his theory test this morning. Practical booked for over the summer

So I bumped into Kate at the school gates and she said her sister's had the baby, a little girl, born on Sunday, both doing fine. Kate's going up to Leeds to see them sometime next week and she's knackered already. I should drop a card round for her sister before Kate goes so she can take it up with her.
Anjali starts at the hospital on Monday. First proper job since qualifying
christening for Simone's twins is early March, at the church on Mill Lane. Lunch afterwards at her parents'
need to ask Wiremu how his audition went. it was yesterday afternoon
Adriana Garcia, new manager, starts the 3rd. Seems nice, two kids, ex-Deloitte

Gustavo results day Thursday. His mum says he hasn't slept properly all week and keeps refreshing the uni portal even though nothing comes out till 8am. He's got an offer from Leeds for engineering if he gets the grades, and Manchester as his backup. Text him that morning, then ring his mum in the afternoon once they know
Alina's leaving the firm end of the month, moving to a startup in Bristol. Drinks are the night before her last day
Lindiwe and her partner Tobi expecting their second, due over the summer. Their eldest Zoe is starting nursery around the same time
Valentina failed her driving test again. Gutted. Don't bring it up for a bit, maybe check in sometime next week
Camila - grade 8 piano exam. 14th. wants to do music at uni

Voice note. Okay so just off the phone with Shira, um, her dad's retiring at the end of the month after forty years at the same garage, and they're throwing him a surprise party the Saturday after. She asked if I could do a speech. I said yes, I'm doing the speech. Also her dog Biscuit had his op on Tuesday and he's recovering fine.
Jonah got into the National Youth Theatre!! Audition was in May, found out this morning. Massive.
remind me to ring Tomás the day after his interview
Hannah's gone back to work after maternity leave, three days a week. Finding it hard leaving the baby. Check in with her end of the week
felix 11+ next sat. parents more stressed than him lol
Chioma's baby shower is cancelled, she's on bed rest. Her mum's moved in to help for a few weeks
Chris has handed his notice in. Last day is the 30th and he hasn't got anything lined up yet. Bit worried about him tbh
Hoang passed his PhD viva yesterday!! Dr Hoang now. Graduation sometime in December
Zainab's first day as a teaching assistant today. Ask her how it went
Leon's mum Suzanne is retiring. Big do at the golf club early March. Leon wants to get her a proper watch, I said I'd chip in
pick up the dry cleaning before Thursday
Interview at Novak & Sons Tuesday 10am. Iron the blue shirt the night before

Uma's 20 week scan was today, all fine. Finding out the gender a week after at a private one, Farid's mum is coming along. She says the sickness has finally eased off but she's struggling to sleep. Her work leaving date is end of January, and the nursery waiting list wants names down by early March, which feels mad
Spoke to Farid - he's been made partner. Announcement goes out sometime next week, keep it under wraps till then. Must get him something nice
Dalia's daughter is doing her A levels this summer. Wants to study medicine. Dalia says she's been revising every evening and barely eating
Kate's husband Reggie lost his job on Friday. Redundancy, whole department went. Kate says he's okay but she's not sure. I need to text Reggie, not Kate
emeka n alice's wedding is off. they split up last month apparently
Asha mentioned she'd love a good pair of gardening gloves and some bulbs for when she retires. Note for the leaving present

Okay so Anjali's sister. No wait, not her sister. Anjali's cousin Simone is the one doing her bar exams in early March, and Anjali said she's absolutely terrified, failed the first attempt last year. I should send her a card the week before.
Wiremu's new puppy is called Kiwi apparently. Got her the day after his promotion as a treat to himself
Gustavo Bianchi (Gus) — dentist, Alina's brother. Lives in Brighton
Valentina is pregnant! 12 week scan was this morning. Due end of April. She asked me to be godmother, christening sometime after
Need to ask Camila how the audition at the conservatoire went. And whether she's heard back about the scholarship
Shira's son Tobi starts secondary school in September. Shes worried he won't know anyone

Lunch with Jonah and Hannah. Jonah's applying for the deputy head job at his school, interview is sometime next week, and he has to teach a sample lesson the day before. Hannah's off on maternity from the end of the month, baby due early December, and they're still decorating the nursery. They both look exhausted. Their cat Mochi keeps sleeping in the cot apparently

Tomás starts at Garcia Logistics on the 1st. Commute's going to be brutal, 90 mins each way, so he's thinking about moving closer sometime over the summer once probation's done. His girlfriend Shira isn't keen, her whole family's here. He was in a good mood though, first job in ages that actually uses his degree
hannahs mum had a fall, in hospital overnight. not serious but hannah's shaken
Felix's dad Chris passed his driving test at 52! First go. Took him out for a pint afterwards

Chioma had the baby!!! Boy, 7lb 2, born 4am this morning after a really long labour. Name TBC, her husband Emeka wants to name him after his late dad. They're keeping them in for a couple of nights because of her blood pressure. Send flowers to the house the day after they're home, not to the hospital, and maybe drop a lasagne round the week after
Note to self: Hoang hates fuss, so no surprise party for the graduation. Maybe just dinner
Zainab's doing her driving test the morning after her birthday. Don't forget to message her that morning
Leon got the job in Edinburgh. Moves up end of the month. Him and his girlfriend Lindiwe are doing long distance for a bit
Suzanne Zhou from next door has a new cat, Pepper. Her granddaughter Alice is staying with her over the summer while her parents are abroad
sort car insurance renewal sometime next week
Mrs Dubois at work is retiring after Easter. Collection going round, I should put in a tenner and sign the card
Uncle Farid had his hip done last week. Going round to see him on Saturday. Auntie Uma says he's grumpy but on the mend
Asha's son Emeka did his GCSE results today. Got 8s and 9s. She's over the moon. Text Emeka congrats later
dalia nervous abt her first day at the new place monday. new role, new team. wish her luck sunday night
Kate Mensah, Anjali's mum. Teaches maths at St Peter's. Massive Arsenal fan

Just had coffee with Reggie and Simone. They're trying for a baby, been about a year now and it's hard on Simone. Reggie's starting a new job early March so they're waiting till after that for the next round of IVF. Don't mention any of it to anyone and be gentle with Simone. Maybe invite her for a walk sometime next week, just the two of us.
Gustavo's promotion to head chef got pushed back to the new year. He's annoyed but trying to be philosophical
Alina's wife Adriana is due in two weeks. Alina's on paternity, sorry, parental leave from the day after. Wants a baby carrier, apparently
Camila said her grandad's retiring from the bakery after 50 years. The whole street's having a party for him over the summer
Valentina - follow up on the job offer. She was waiting to hear back after the second interview on Wednesday

ok so long one. Chris told me at work today he's leaving at the end of the month, going back to uni to retrain as a nurse. His wife Zoe is pregnant too, due in the spring, so it's a big year. He's nervous about the entrance test next Thursday. Remind me to text him the night before and ask how it went the day after. And chip in for his leaving present.
